verdict.rationale: Consensus documents an AI-powered Library workspace where users import their own papers (Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, RIS) and then search, find gaps, and put the collection to work. Around that sit in-product AI synthesis with citations, Consensus Meter aggregation, PICO extraction and Citation Graph suggestions of related work. This covers AI-generated insights and suggestions inside the product, but the specifics of what it surfaces from a user's own library are thin marketing claims. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the insight and suggestion outputs generated over the user's own library, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
